name: Aditya Consumer Marketing Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 2002, Aditya Consumer Marketing Ltd is engaged in establishment 
and operation of Departmental Stores, Super Market Retailing in consumer items, F&B and services[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
ACML is in the business of Multi-Location 
 Retail Super Market, Food & Beverages (Restaurants & take away), Banquet, 
Beauty & Hair Salon in Patna & Gaya

pros: Promoter holding has increased by 3.75% over last quarter.
cons: Stock is trading at 3.48 times its book value
Company has low interest coverage ratio.
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 0.90% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 1.40% over last 3 years.
